whyItMatters: Digest::SHA1.hexdigest computes SHA-1 in ruby, whose collisions defeat security reliance on the digest.
actions: Replace Digest::SHA1.hexdigest with Digest::SHA256.hexdigest wherever the digest protects signatures or untrusted data.
For remaining compatibility uses, add a comment stating SHA-1 is intentional.
Re-run the scan and confirm every remaining hit carries that justification.
verification: Rescan shows no unjustified Digest::SHA1.hexdigest, and security digests verify under the replacement.
